About Mobexa

A dependable link between quality materials and finished products.

Supporting the people and businesses behind the bags people carry every day.

Who we are

Built around the needs of manufacturers.

Welcome to Mobexa World Trade, a manufacturing-supply partner and wholesale trader based in Sadar Bazar, Delhi. Managed under the leadership of Md. Usman Ghani, we serve the luggage, backpack and fashion bag manufacturing industries with a broad range of raw materials and production components.

We understand that the durability and finish of a bag depend on the materials and fittings used to make it. Our supply range brings together fabrics, hardware, fittings and structural components that manufacturers need throughout the production process.

Our focus is straightforward: dependable material quality, competitive wholesale pricing and punctual delivery timelines. Whether you operate a large manufacturing facility or a boutique workshop, we aim to support your requirements with a practical, reliable supply partnership.
